results.prediction: Maxwell clemency decision by Trump DOJ

results.prediction: Iran war ceasefire or major escalation
results.description: The Iran-US conflict remains active with ongoing diplomatic efforts but no ceasefire achieved. Iran has rejected the US 15-point peace plan and issued its own counterproposal demanding reparations and sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Trump declared a ceasefire on June 24 according to one source, though other reports indicate Iran denies any direct talks are taking place.

results.prediction: Strait of Hormuz full shipping restoration
results.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed to most commercial shipping as of late March 2026, with Iran maintaining control through mines and selective passage permissions. While some Chinese, Malaysian, and other select vessels have been granted passage, approximately 1,000-2,000 ships remain stranded and tanker traffic is down roughly 70% since the closure began March 1, 2026. Full shipping restoration has not occurred.

results.prediction: Oracle Stargate financial restructuring or default
results.description: Oracle is undergoing significant financial stress related to its AI infrastructure investments, including Stargate. The company has taken on $58 billion in new debt over two months in 2026, with total outstanding debt reaching $120 billion. Oracle's credit default swap spreads hit a record high of 198.18 basis points, and the company announced a $2.1 billion restructuring plan including layoffs of up to 30,000 employees to free up $8-10 billion in cash flow. Multiple securities fraud class action lawsuits have been filed against Oracle with an April 6, 2026 deadline for lead plaintiff appointments.

results.prediction: TikTok USDS JV lawsuit outcome or Congressional review action
results.description: ByteDance completed restructuring of TikTok's U.S. operations into TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC in January 2026, with 80% ownership by non-Chinese investors including Oracle. The joint venture oversees data protection, algorithm security, content moderation, and software assurance in the U.S. market. While ByteDance filed a lawsuit challenging the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act in May 2024, no specific lawsuit outcomes or Congressional review actions regarding the USDS joint venture structure have been identified in current search results.

results.prediction: Schedule Policy/Career legal challenge succeeds or fails
results.description: Schedule Policy/Career legal challenges are actively proceeding through federal courts with mixed preliminary outcomes. The NTEU has filed amended complaints following the March 2026 implementation, while the Ninth Circuit vacated a preliminary injunction against Executive Order 14,251 regarding federal collective bargaining exclusions. A separate VA-AFGE case shows ongoing enforcement issues with labor contract restoration orders.

results.prediction: Mojtaba Khamenei confirmed as Supreme Leader of Iran
results.description: Mojtaba Khamenei was officially selected as Iran's third Supreme Leader by the Assembly of Experts on March 8, 2026, following his father Ali Khamenei's assassination during the 2026 Iran war. The 88-member clerical body chose him in what was reported as both a unanimous vote and separately as receiving 59 out of 88 votes, above the required two-thirds majority.
